tools.name: setup_guide
tools.description: Step-by-step guide to set up a macOS or Linux machine so AI agents can be run and checked from an iPhone or iPad: SSH, tmux, Tailscale, keep-awake, SSH key, verify.

tools.name: tmux_howto
tools.description: Exact tmux commands for common tasks from a phone: attach, detach, list, kill, scrollback, mouse, copy, rename, new session, windows and panes.

tools.name: generate_tmux_conf
tools.description: Return a phone-friendly ~/.tmux.conf snippet (session-name titles, mouse scrolling, OSC 52 clipboard, long history, optional Ctrl-a prefix) plus how to apply it.

tools.name: troubleshoot_connection
tools.description: Fixes for common phone-to-machine problems: connection timeout, connection refused, tmux "can't find session", copy from tmux not reaching the phone.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "setup_guide" references sensitive artifacts (ssh key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
